correctness.rationale: The seven characters \(\chi^h\) for \(-3\le h\le3\) are distinct when chi has order >=7 or infinite. Parseval of |F|^2 gives the exact \(s^2+2\sum_h|R_h|^2\) formula. Cauchy--Schwarz on the outer/inner magnitude pairs bounds the three correlations simultaneously by \(2AB+B^2,2AB,A^2\), with \(s=2(A^2+B^2)\). The resulting rational function \(H(t)\) has derivative \(-2(3t^3+3t^2-3t-1)/(1+t^2)^3\) and a unique positive global maximizer rho. Equality in the outer/inner geometric means and lag-one triangle inequality forces amplitudes \((\rho,1,1,\rho)\) and linear phase increments; these attain the bound. Positive frequency aliasing when chi has order 4, 5, 6 proves the exact sampling threshold. The package checker executes 4,060 finite-group tests, corroborative but not used as a universal proof. No unproved nonstandard lemma is invoked.
